answer_2.quote: We measure the sample quality of the generated waveform using both objective metrics and subjective indicators. The objective metrics we collected are ... (1) RT60 Error (RTE) ... (2) Mel Cepstral Distortion (MCD) ...

answer_4.quote: We use crowd-sourced human evaluation via Amazon Mechanical Turk, where raters are asked to rate Mean Opinion Score (MOS) on a 1-5 Likert scale. The testers are explicitly instructed to "focus on examining the audio quality, naturalness and whether the audio matches with the given image."
answer_4.guideline: Raters evaluate audio quality, naturalness, and image-audio matching on a 1-5 Likert scale.
